comment: USER 2026-10-14 (Fluctuator): 'Why can't we use a land drawn by cycling? We should be able to consider it whether this is in a go-off heuristic or actual search.' The draft's §4.3 line on a board with no red and no dual: Fluctuator out, Polluted Mire + Blasted Landscape, no land in hand, the drop open. The free chain draws Capital City, then Drannith Stinger. Dropping the City (fed {1} for R) casts the Stinger off the other land, and the 30 Polluted Mires below cycle for 30 pings -- a T3 kill. Before MTG_FLUCT_DRAWN_LAND the land draw never re-solved, the Stinger draw read 'uncastable' (the open drop was not counted) and the City was rank-3 fodder, so the line was unreachable at any budget. (On the draft's own pair, Mire + Irrigated Farmland, the pool's dual 'wild' already over-credits the Stinger as castable, so the old dig loop re-solved there by accident.) Twin: fluctuator_drawn_land_after_stinger.json.
